source.author: verg
source.text: Invadunt urbem somno vinoque sepultam; caeduntur vigiles, portisque patentibus omnis accipiunt socios atque agmina conscia iungunt.
source.text_original: Invadunt urbem somno vinoque sepultam; / caeduntur vigiles, portisque patentibus omnis / accipiunt socios atque agmina conscia iungunt.
source.text_english: They storm the city, buried in sleep and wine; the watchmen are cut down, and with the gates open they admit all their comrades and join the aware ranks together.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: profugo quin agmina iungere Phrixo abnuit Inoas ultro nec venit ad aras, imperii sed parte virum nataeque moratus coningio videt e Graia nunc stirpe nepotes et generos vocat et iunctas sibi sanguine terras.
reuse.text_original: profugo quin agmina iungere Phrixo / abnuit Inoas ultro nec venit ad aras, / imperii sed parte virum nataeque moratus / coningio videt e Graia nunc stirpe nepotes / et generos vocat et iunctas sibi sanguine terras.
reuse.text_english: though she refused to join the troops to the fugitive Phrixus, and did not of her own accord come to the altars of Ino, but, delayed by his daughter’s marriage and by a share in power, he now sees grandsons from the Greek line and calls them sons-in-law and lands joined to him by blood.
